title: Omdia Webinar
subject: Omdia Webinar
body:
AI is changing what customers need from their data infrastructure. Fragmented environments, operational complexity and growing data demands can make it harder to move fast.

The Omdia webinar, What Modern Data Infrastructure Looks Like in the AI Era, gives you a timely way to start conversations around building a stronger data foundation for AI and hybrid environments.

The session explores how organizations can simplify operations, consolidate data and storage silos, improve efficiency through automation and prepare infrastructure for new workloads.

To help you take that message to market, the Hybrid Cloud Platform & Operations campaign is ready in the Partner Marketing Hub with co-brandable emails, social content and customer-facing assets.

Activate Campaign Now

Watch the webinar, activate the campaign and bring the AI infrastructure conversation to your customers.

Thank you for being a valued partner!
Partner Marketing Team
